gate: Only after unchanged repeat final audit and root authorization. No runtime source application, build or observation run authorized by this design.

sourceFacts.fact: requestCountdownStart optionally calls prepareCountdownAudio, then can set pendingCountdownStart and return. No visible countdown mutation occurs in that deferred branch.

Existing audio preparation onChange consumes pending countdown and routes to beginVisibleCountdown or requestCountdownStart. A delayed observer can delay application action; source does not identify why it is delayed.
No-ready/disabled-audio branch calls beginVisibleCountdown immediately using captured now.
Ready-audio branch computes armUptime from captured now plus policy lead; calls startCountdown, then creates MainActor Task.

Arm Task sleeps until max(0, armUptime-currentMonotonicTime), handles cancellation, clears countdownArmTask and calls beginVisibleCountdown with original armUptime. Task closure entry and continuation can occur later than creation/intended deadline.

beginVisibleCountdown synchronously mutates session state. Initial activeStartUptime is based on supplied armUptime+3seconds, while routineStartedAt uses Date() sampled when mutation executes. Therefore delayed Task execution can produce an already-expired monotonic countdown; this is a possible source path, not observed cause.

Surface task begins after SwiftUI schedules it, sets loading, awaits BoardModelRealityLoader.load, then cancellation-checks and publishes ready. Appearance does not guarantee load task immediately ran.

Existing board-scene constructor marker executes in initializer; load asynchronously imports Entity, binds material/contact geometry and sets framing before loader can return. Existing constructor marker plus load-call/return spans distinguish delay before vs after construction without new entity reads.

RealityView make occurs only after ready scene is supplied to that view. Existing view-make logs after content.add and applySync; it is not precise callback-entry time, although existing counter make timestamp provides that if enabled.

proposedSparseSites.when: Immediately after existing prepareCountdownAudio call, only if that branch runs
After existing pendingCountdownStart assignment and before existing return
First statement inside existing onChange, before original guard/consume
Immediately before/after existing startCountdown call; no new call to audio APIs
Existing Task closure entry, after existing sleep returns, or in existing catch respectively; cancellation flag recorded before original guard
After original loading assignment before await; immediately after await before original cancellation guard; after original ready assignment; inside original catch before its cancellation guard
fields: returnedSceneLifecycleToken only after actual loader return

recorderContract.existingHarnessLimitation: HangTen/Models/BoardModelRealityTypes.swift:2044 harnessEvent always calls applicationCensus(), which walks UIKit/window/renderer placements. Avoid that extra observation for startup timing.
recorderContract.proposedMethod: DEBUG startupObservation(event:String, fields:[String:Any]) gated by immutable launch flag, forwarding scalar-only fields through existing emit. emit already appends sequence/epoch/uptime and existing hand counters. No applicationCensus, scene traversal or forced lazy access.
recorderContract.scalarData: Booleans, strings, finite monotonic numeric times; nil explicitly NSNull or string nil. No object descriptions that could force work. Local load UUID identifies overlapping await attempts; it is local to the already-existing Task, not State/Observable.
recorderContract.ordering: Capture call placement is the ordering evidence. Existing emit time is not the exact start of an audio/loader API; each before/after span contains logging overhead. Avoid a new Task solely to emit. No awaits added or moved.
recorderContract.limits: Log allocation and synchronous file writes can perturb MainActor scheduling. Same observation flag/source would be common to any compared startup paths. No body/per-frame logs, new callbacks, subscriptions, timers, sleeps, SceneEvents or forced redraw.

boundedObservation.basis: Parent reports approximately20second construction gap. Thirty seconds is a reasonable bounded chance to bracket that observed scale, not a guarantee. Existing recorder-open and appearance epoch identify anchors.
boundedObservation.method: External owner helper reads complete JSONL only with a fixed30second post-appearance deadline and separately bounded startup-to-appearance wait. Keep original app recipe/flags/audio; do not wait for a color phase, tap, skip, restart or alter countdown. Stop observation/terminate exact owned app through existing owner lifecycle afterward.
boundedObservation.noFirstHangRequirement: Missing first Hang/countdown or load-return is an outcome in this startup-only observation; preserve partial spans at deadline instead of starting another long color capture.
boundedObservation.noAutomaticExtension: If marker pair does not close by30seconds, report right-censored interval and exact last marker. Do not claim cause or silently extend.
boundedObservation.noInternalTimer: Bound belongs to external helper; app has no new sampling task or timer.

interpretationExamples: Long request→deferred→audio-state-change interval localizes waiting before resuming countdown; no attribution to audio framework internals without further evidence.
arm planned vs task-entry/resumed vs actual mutation distinguishes scheduling latency from recorded planned deadline.

Visible countdown mutation before Surface load-call distinguishes session timing from delayed view/task scheduling; load-call→constructor vs constructor→return separates preconstruction and import/setup spans.
load-return/ready-published→view-make separates published scene from later host construction; no inference of presented frame or GPU availability.
Multiple local load UUIDs/cancellations must remain separate; never combine a cancelled attempt start with another successful attempt return.
reasonDesignOnly: Exact hook sites and scalar schema provided; no need to change source while final repeat gate is pending. Root may select the minimum markers from this reviewed design.
